scope: Fixed EV-003 final inputs, scoring references, finite sample/family/aggregate ceilings and deterministic order. Native runtime/resources/accounting remain per-participant/family execution prerequisites. This is Inspect input metadata, not a new runner or result format.

scorer.resultOwner: Native Inspect logs/scorer; no duplicated score table

models.providerRoute: Existing registered subscription routes only; no paid fallback or automatic model escalation

budgetBasis.classification: Engineering ceilings grounded in existing development observations and installed grants; not measured complete-turn consumption, expected expenditure or a guarantee that every scenario will fit.
budgetBasis.contactMemoryDerivation: Two foreground responses observed in the accepted M1 recall, plus native extraction/consolidation lifecycle. Four attempts is an explicit composition of separate observations. Per-response limits reuse the existing 65,536 input / 1,200 output runtime envelope. Wall/tool limits retain the known 120-second/four-dispatch dialogue allowance.
budgetBasis.workDerivation: Reuse the installed 32-response/31-tool/300-second native task grant, supported by HA/browser/learning traces. Count every actual provider attempt, including failed or retried requests, inside the shared envelope even where native grants count completed responses.
budgetBasis.workUnitsPerFamily: Conversation/memory requires no delegated work unit. Cross-domain, browser, learning and voice allow one possible work admission per maximum user/audio input. Initiative allows the initial opportunity plus three fixture events; opportunities and distractors receive the same allowance. Units are not mandatory toolcalls or a cap on how many useful subtasks an agent may divide its work into.
budgetBasis.speechDerivation: Voice permits one recognition and one synthesis request per maximum input, plus one interrupted-output continuation. This seven-request ceiling is an explicit engineering choice, not a measured complete voice scenario. All audio processing, waiting, playback and observation remain inside the shared wall budget. Native input/output duration and usage must be recorded before family admission.
budgetBasis.oldDevelopmentLimits: Unchanged. Historical two-attempt results stay incomplete. The six-response offline memory fixture is wiring evidence, not real model token or latency calibration.
budgetBasis.nativeOutputLimitNote: Token usage is observed cumulatively; an in-flight provider response may overshoot a requested cap. Record actual overshoot and stop further dispatch. Do not claim a hard provider-side output cap.

executionOrder.caseOrder: Ascending public commitment case ID within family
executionOrder.hashRecipe: JSON list of {epoch,family,caseId,caseSha256,participant}; epoch then family then sorted case then specified participant order; sorted keys and compact separators; UTF-8.
executionOrder.freshState: Fresh isolated instance/data per case and epoch; preserve state, clocks and counters inside one scenario. Setup inputs and all fixture event handling count.

executionPrerequisites: Pin actual source/images/config/model settings and equal requested capabilities for each participant/family.
Use the existing trusted native private bindings and household authority; unknown/shared speaker cannot become a private owner.
Provision actual required fixture resources and controlled native clocks/events; hidden fixture/oracle values remain with the independent curator.
Demonstrate complete bound accounting for every foreground/planning/helper/memory/retry request, native cancellation and independent effect readback.
Enforce one cumulative sample and aggregate counter across concurrent tasks, process restart and resume; no reset, free setup, or role exemptions.
Voice requires actual audio input/output/playback and physical listening; human scores remain independent. Text-only substitutes are not admitted.
Submit the sealed plan hash, dataset hash, candidate hash and actual adapter/runtime receipts to native Inspect metadata before any final provider call.

review.verdict: GO for preparation only; all refs/arithmetic and independently reconstructed schedule verified. No native execution admission.
review.curatorBudgetAssessment: /root/aide_final_evaluation: finite engineering ceilings grounded in separate development observations and installed grants are acceptable without a new live budget-only probe; all native calls must debit one shared sample counter.
review.postReviewChanges: Freeze status/time and this review metadata only. Numerical limits, ordering and prerequisites unchanged.
